summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the scroll-storytelling Prokritir Jol landing page. Verified all 6 chapters render at correct scroll progress, cap-lift animation triggers between progress 0.55-0.78, chapter rail hides on mobile, nav stays fixed, no horizontal overflow at 1440/1920/390 viewports, all data-testids present, and mission overlay does not overlap the top nav.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx imports `useSpring` from framer-motion but only uses it for the top progress bar — fine, however the comment says spring is used only for the bar which matches the code, so ok.

The invisible chapter anchors inside <section ref={storyRef}> use position:absolute with top expressed as a percentage of the section height. This works because the section is position:relative. Note: a benign console warning appears during scene mount ('Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...') — usually triggered by framer-motion before the section ref renders. Non-blocking.
BackgroundStage: tubewell inset is hidden on `lg:` breakpoints only; on 1440 viewport it is visible correctly. No issue.

BottleScene: cap y translates up to -320px via clip-path 'inset(0 0 88.5% 0)'. Verified in DOM cap image has translate transform of -158px at ~y=3100 (progress ≈ 0.664), reaching greater translation as user continues scrolling — cap-lift works as designed.
ChapterRail stops at [0.05, 0.28, 0.5, 0.65, 0.8, 0.95] correspond reasonably to chapter progress ranges. All rail testids present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site, no backend. Testing at viewport 1440x900. Story track is 6*100vh (5400px story region → progress 0..1 over scrollY 0..4500). Chapter probes: Hero ~y=100, Source ~y=1260, Purity ~y=2160, Reveal/cap-lift ~y=2925-3240, People ~y=3735, Mission ~y=4320, Footer starts past ~y=5400. IMPORTANT: html has scroll-behavior:smooth. When using window.scrollTo(), always wait 600-800ms and re-read window.scrollY before asserting on framer-motion opacities/transforms — quick successive scrollTos may not reach the target y in time (framer-motion opacities remained stale at 0 in first pass). Verified all data-testids present: site-nav, brand-link, nav-source/purity/people/mission, cta-order, chapter-rail, rail-hero..rail-mission, scroll-progress, bottle-scene, chapter-hero..chapter-mission, cta-learn-more, cta-order-mission, site-footer, social-in/fb/x/ig. No horizontal scrollbar at 1440/1920/390. Chapter rail correctly hidden (display:none) on mobile 390. Nav is position:fixed with z-index 60; mission chapter heading sits at y=311 while nav bottom is at y=93 → no overlap. Cap-lift verified via cap transform matrix showing negative translateY (-158px at progress 0.664, -232px at 0.717, -286px at 0.755).
